prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Houston after a car wreck. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
I’m sorry you were in a wreck — that’s stressful. I can help you find the right lawyer. Before I pull together specific phone numbers, a quick question: do you want a large firm with big resources, a smaller local firm with more personal attention, or a trial-ready attorney who will definitely take the case to court if needed? Any language needs (Spanish), insurance carrier, or very serious injuries I should know about?

If you want immediate names to call, start with this mix (reasons included) plus the local referral resources below:

Specific firms to call (why)
- Morgan & Morgan (Houston office) — large national plaintiff’s firm with significant resources and experience handling auto-accident claims and catastrophic-injury cases; works on contingency so you pay only if they recover.
- The Cochran Firm (Houston) — nationally known plaintiff firm that handles serious car-wreck and wrongful-death cases; experience with complex liability and aggressive negotiation/trial work.

Why also use local referral services
- Harris County Bar Association lawyer referral service — they can quickly match you to board-certified personal-injury trial lawyers in Houston who handle car wrecks.
- Texas Trial Lawyers Association (TTLA) or local trial lawyer organizations — good for finding trial-experienced attorneys and peer-reviewed specialists.

How to choose which to hire (key questions to ask on the initial call)
- Do you handle car-accident/personal-injury cases? How many per year?
- Will my case be handled by the named attorney or a team/paralegal?
- Do you take cases on contingency? What is your fee percentage and what expenses will I be responsible for?
- Have you handled cases like mine (similar injuries, fault issues)? Any representative results (they can provide examples)?
- What is your trial experience and how many cases have you taken to jury trial recently?
- How will you communicate with me (phone/email/text) and how often?
- Do you handle medical liens and bills, or will I be responsible for paying them out of pocket?

What to bring to a free consultation or to have ready for phone intake
- Police report number or copy
- Photos of damage, vehicle, and injuries
- Medical records and bills, hospital/ER records
- Insurance cards (yours and the other driver’s), claim numbers
- Witness names/phone numbers
- Notes of the crash timeline and any statements you gave

Next steps I can do for you
- Draft a short phone script you can use to call firms
- Help prioritize firms based on your preference (big firm vs. boutique vs. bilingual)
- If you want, tell me any preferences and I’ll list 4–6 Houston firms (with brief reasons) for you to call

Which type of firm do you prefer, and do you want that call script now?
